about: Franklin Covey Co. provides training and consulting services and related products in Australia, Austria, China, France, Germany, Ireland, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: North America, International, and Education Division. The company offers a suite of individual and leadership-development training content based on books, including the 7 Habits of Highly Effective People, the Speed of Trust, Multipliers, the 4 Disciplines of Execution, and Trust and Inspire, as well as content in the areas of execution, sales performance, productivity, customer loyalty, leadership, and education. It also owns international licensees to provide offerings and services. In addition, the company is involved in the education practice operations, including international education licensees that focuses on sales to educational institutions, such as elementary schools, middle schools, high schools, and colleges and universities. It serves individuals, teams, and organizations. The company was formerly known as Franklin Quest Co. and changed its name to Franklin Covey Co. in May 1997. Franklin Covey Co. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Draper, Utah.
